# FlowOS Documentation

> Official documentation for FlowOS, a low-code platform for building and deploying AI-powered agents and workflows with a visual builder, API, and MCP server. Technical documentation for developers, data scientists, and teams building RAG and multi-agent applications.

FlowOS is open source (MIT). Run locally with `uv run flowos run` (Python 3.10–3.14, default http://127.0.0.1:7860). Also available as FlowOS Desktop (Windows, macOS). Key areas: get started (installation, quickstart, tutorials), flows (build, run via API or webhooks, test, import/export), agents and MCP, develop (config, storage, observability), deploy (Docker, Kubernetes, cloud), components reference, and API reference.

## Docs

- [About FlowOS](https://docs.flowos.org/about-flowos): Platform overview and introduction
- [Install FlowOS](https://docs.flowos.org/get-started-installation): Installation options (OSS, Docker, from source)
- [Quickstart](https://docs.flowos.org/get-started-quickstart): Get up and running quickly
- [Use the visual editor](https://docs.flowos.org/concepts-overview): Visual flow builder overview
- [Trigger flows with the API](https://docs.flowos.org/concepts-publish): Run flows via the FlowOS API
- [Agents](https://docs.flowos.org/agents): Agents and tools
- [MCP client and server](https://docs.flowos.org/mcp-client): Model Context Protocol integration
- [Deployment overview](https://docs.flowos.org/deployment-overview): How to deploy FlowOS
- [Security](https://docs.flowos.org/security): Deployment and security guidance
- [Release notes](https://docs.flowos.org/release-notes): Version history and release notes
